raw: {"analysis":"GKG correctly sequences the work so baselines are updated only after dual human approval, and it keeps verification local before triggering the expensive CI snapshot run. GQB also enforces local verification and dual sign-off, but it is less explicit about the critical ordering of baseline updates relative to visual inspection, and it conflates local verification against a staging data mirror in a slightly muddier way. GKG additionally specifies independent code review and a rollback command drafted before merge, which are useful operational details.","verdict": "GKG"}
